title: Frontier Safety Framework Report - Gemini 3 Pro (November, 2025) v2
venue: Google DeepMind Frontier Safety Framework report
paper_type_zh: 前沿安全框架报告与数据披露台账
best_for_zh: 需要审查前沿推理模型的后训练数据对象、奖励边界、智能体评测脚手架与可审计性缺口的读者
one_line: Google DeepMind's Gemini 3 Pro FSF report discloses model-generated thought traces for SFT, RL length penalties on thoughts, high-level guardrails, and concrete evaluation scaffolding, but not the underlying prompts, traces, rewards, or reproducibility artifacts.
Google DeepMind 的 Gemini 3 Pro FSF 报告披露了用于 SFT 的推理模型生成 thought traces、施加于 thought 的 RL 长度惩罚、高层 guardrails 和具体评测脚手架，但未公开底层 prompts、traces、奖励或可复现制品。
why: It makes a closed frontier post-training interface partially auditable: the report separates model-generated thought-trace SFT from reward handling and exposes evaluation-budget confounders, while making clear why data, reward, and audit reuse remains impossible.
inclusion_reason: A major-lab frontier safety report that unusually discloses SFT thought traces generated by reasoning models, RL length penalties on thoughts, non-thought reward boundaries, agent-evaluation scaffolds, and selected attempt budgets while retaining the underlying data, rewards, and artifacts as undisclosed.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Frontier safety reports can establish an important capability and mitigation narrative while withholding the data, feedback, and audit artifacts required to inspect a post-training pipeline. For reasoning systems, a statement that reinforcement learning was used is insufficient: prompt provenance, trace schema, reward contract, filtering, rollout construction, and evaluation controls determine whether the claim can be independently assessed.

Gemini 3 Pro is relevant to Track 12 because its official Frontier Safety Framework (FSF) report makes several unusually specific stage-level disclosures. It says supervised fine-tuning uses thought traces generated by reasoning models, and that RL on thoughts includes length penalties while, with minor exceptions, other rewards do not reference thoughts. The same report does not release the underlying prompts, traces, generators, reward implementation, or reproducibility artifacts. This Card records that disclosure boundary rather than treating the report as a training-data release.

前沿安全报告可以给出重要的能力和缓解措施叙事，却仍不公开检查后训练管线所需的数据、反馈和审计制品。对于推理系统，仅说明使用了强化学习并不充分：prompt 溯源、trace 模式、奖励契约、过滤、rollout 构造和评测控制，决定了该主张能否被独立审查。

Gemini 3 Pro 与 Track 12 相关，因为其官方 Frontier Safety Framework（FSF）报告做出了若干罕见的阶段级披露。报告称，监督微调使用由推理模型生成的 thought traces；对 thought 的 RL 包含长度惩罚，而除少数例外外，其他奖励不参考 thought。同一报告未发布底层 prompts、traces、生成器、奖励实现或可复现制品。本卡片记录这一披露边界，而不将该报告视为训练数据发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The official report assesses Gemini 3 Pro against Frontier Safety Framework critical-capability levels in CBRN, cyber, harmful manipulation, ML R&D, and exploratory misalignment risk. Its Track 12 contribution is not a reusable dataset or executable recipe. It is a partial disclosure of the interface between reasoning traces, post-training rewards, deployment guardrails, and evaluation scaffolding.

At the post-training level, Google DeepMind reports model-generated thought traces for SFT and an RL stage with thought-length penalties. The report additionally distinguishes those penalties from other rewards, which are generally computed without reference to thoughts. It describes mitigations such as query filters, input filtering or processing, prompt-injection defenses, safety-aligned fine-tuning, and red-team feedback. These statements identify mechanisms and boundaries but not the records, algorithms, or implementations needed to reproduce them.

官方报告按照 Frontier Safety Framework 的关键能力等级评估 Gemini 3 Pro，范围包括 CBRN、网络安全、有害操纵、ML R&D 和探索性的失配风险。它对 Track 12 的贡献不是一个可复用数据集或可执行配方，而是对推理 traces、后训练奖励、部署 guardrails 和评测脚手架之间接口的部分披露。

在后训练层面，Google DeepMind 报告了由模型生成、用于 SFT 的 thought traces，以及一个包含 thought 长度惩罚的 RL 阶段。报告还区分了这些惩罚和其他奖励：后者通常不参考 thought。它描述了 query filters、输入过滤或处理、prompt-injection defenses、安全对齐微调和用于改善缓解覆盖面的 red-team feedback 等缓解措施。这些陈述标识了机制和边界，却没有给出复现所需的记录、算法或实现。

title: Method
方法
html:
The FSF report states that SFT uses thought traces generated by reasoning models. It does not identify the upstream prompts or tasks, trace-generator identities or checkpoints, trace schema, sampling settings, selection rule, human involvement, source rights, or released examples. It reports that RL on thought traces includes length penalties and that, with minor exceptions, other rewards are computed without reference to thoughts. Reward equations, reward weights, verifiers, labelers, calibration, aggregation, algorithm, optimizer, schedule, rollout generation, and update rules are unknown. The report therefore supports SFT and RL as high-level training-use claims, but not RLVR or a reproducible feedback contract.

The report also describes safety query filters, input filtering and processing, other guardrails, and red-team feedback used to improve mitigation coverage. It does not disclose the data-selection rules, thresholds, yields, or training linkage of those mechanisms. For cyber evaluation, a custom controller runs a multi-stage thinking and tool-use loop, retries parsing or validation errors up to five times, and uses model- and task-specific tools. Gemini 3 Pro is evaluated with 75 attempts and 40-step challenges; these are evaluation settings, not post-training rollout counts or a deployed inference budget.

FSF 报告称，SFT 使用由推理模型生成的 thought traces。它没有识别上游 prompts 或任务、trace 生成器身份或 checkpoints、trace 模式、采样设置、选择规则、人工参与、来源权利或已发布示例。报告称，对 thought traces 的 RL 包含长度惩罚；除少数例外外，其他奖励不参考 thought。奖励方程、奖励权重、verifiers、标注者、校准、聚合、算法、优化器、调度、rollout 生成和更新规则均为 unknown。因此，报告支持将 SFT 和 RL 作为高层训练用途主张，但不支持 RLVR 或可复现的反馈契约。

报告还描述了安全 query filters、输入过滤和处理、其他 guardrails，以及用于改善缓解覆盖面的 red-team feedback。它没有披露这些机制的数据选择规则、阈值、保留率或训练关联。对网络安全评测而言，一个自定义 controller 运行多阶段思考和工具使用循环，在解析或验证出错时最多重试五次，并使用模型和任务特定的工具。Gemini 3 Pro 在该评测中使用 75 次尝试和 40 步挑战；这些是评测设置，而不是后训练 rollout 数或已部署推理预算。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official FSF report directly supports the SFT thought-trace statement and the RL reward boundary in its chain-of-thought monitorability discussion. It also documents the guardrail categories, the cyber controller and retry behavior, the 75-attempt and 40-step cyber-evaluation configuration, and the reported solve predicate of success in at least one of N attempts.

The report describes approximately 75,000 prompts in a third-party harmful-manipulation evaluation and says testers used an SME-validated classification model. It describes internal, external, and third-party evaluation layers, but does not release the prompts, evaluator identity, SME-validation procedure, classifier or rubric, split definitions, or artifacts needed to rerun the work. The official Gemini API release notes corroborate the November 18, 2025 Gemini 3 Pro Preview release timing only; they are not evidence for training details.

官方 FSF 报告 在其 chain-of-thought monitorability 讨论中直接支持 SFT thought-trace 陈述和 RL 奖励边界。它还记录了 guardrail 类别、网络安全 controller 和重试行为、75 次尝试和 40 步网络安全评测配置，以及“在 N 次尝试中至少一次成功”的 solve predicate。

报告描述了一项约 75,000 个 prompts 的第三方有害操纵评测，并称测试者使用了经 SME 验证的分类模型。它描述了内部、外部和第三方评测层，但没有发布 prompts、评估者身份、SME 验证程序、分类器或 rubric、split 定义，或重跑所需制品。官方 Gemini API 发布说明 仅佐证了 2025 年 11 月 18 日 Gemini 3 Pro Preview 的发布时间；它不是训练细节的证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
This is not a data release. Its distinctive Track 12 value is the conjunction of a concrete trace-origin statement, a narrowly stated reward boundary, and disclosed evaluation scaffolding. The report says that reasoning models generate SFT thought traces; it identifies length penalties on thoughts in RL; and it explicitly says that most other rewards are computed without reference to thoughts. That is more informative than a generic statement that a model uses post-training, while still falling far short of a disclosed data or reward pipeline.

The report also makes the confounders around cyber comparisons visible: Gemini 3 Pro receives increased attempt budgets, step limits, and tool affordances relative to earlier models. This Card preserves that boundary so reported safety evidence can be compared without turning the report into a capability leaderboard, a reusable dataset, or a fully specified training recipe.

这不是数据发布。它对 Track 12 的独特价值在于：同时给出了具体的 trace 来源陈述、范围有限的奖励边界和已披露的评测脚手架。报告称推理模型生成用于 SFT 的 thought traces；它识别出 RL 中施加于 thought 的长度惩罚；并明确说明大多数其他奖励不参考 thought。这比“模型使用了后训练”的泛泛表述更有信息量，但距离已披露的数据或奖励管线仍很远。

报告还使网络安全比较中的混杂因素可见：相对早期模型，Gemini 3 Pro 获得了更高的尝试预算、步数上限和工具能力。本卡片保留这一边界，以便比较所报告的安全证据，而不把报告转化为能力排行榜、可复用数据集或完整指定的训练配方。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The report does not release post-training prompts or tasks, thought-trace records, record schema, source manifest, data quantities, generator identities, source rights, licenses, selected or rejected outputs, or item-level lineage. It does not disclose reward equations, non-length reward signals, verifier or labeler contracts, calibration, error audits, aggregation, RL algorithm, optimizer, schedule, rollout generation, checkpoint lineage, or deployed inference budget. No official code, training-data, weights, or evaluation-data artifact is claimed in this Card.

The cyber results cannot be treated as strictly apples-to-apples with earlier-model results because the report gives Gemini 3 Pro additional attempt budget, step limits, and tool affordances. The report describes no released decontamination procedure, evaluation split, raw transcript, task artifact, third-party evaluator identity, rubric implementation, or reproducible tool and environment pins. It reports no sandbagging examples after automated and manual inspection, but the corresponding traces are not released; that finding cannot be independently verified from public artifacts.

报告没有发布后训练 prompts 或任务、thought-trace 记录、记录模式、来源清单、数据数量、生成器身份、来源权利、许可证、入选或拒绝的输出，或条目级谱系。它没有披露奖励方程、非长度奖励信号、verifier 或标注者契约、校准、错误审计、聚合、RL 算法、优化器、调度、rollout 生成、checkpoint 谱系或已部署推理预算。本卡片不声称存在官方代码、训练数据、权重或评测数据制品。

网络安全结果不能被视为与早期模型结果严格同类可比，因为报告给 Gemini 3 Pro 提供了额外的尝试预算、步数上限和工具能力。报告没有发布去污染程序、评测 split、原始 transcripts、任务制品、第三方评估者身份、rubric 实现，或可复现的工具和环境 pins。报告称在自动与人工检查后未发现 sandbagging 示例，但相应 traces 未发布；这一发现无法依据公开制品独立验证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Track 12, this Card supplies a careful comparison point for frontier-report disclosure. It lets readers ask whether a report names the origin and format of a post-training object, distinguishes a reward claim from a reward implementation, separates evaluation scaffolding from training infrastructure, and exposes the budgets and affordances that can affect an agentic safety result.

Use the Card to compare disclosure boundaries across frontier reports and to identify requested evidence for a data, feedback, or audit ledger. Do not use it to reproduce Gemini 3 Pro post-training, infer undisclosed data provenance or rights, label the procedure as RLVR, or convert the cyber-evaluation configuration into a training rollout or product inference claim.

对 Track 12 而言，本卡片为前沿报告披露提供了审慎的比较点。它让读者能够追问：报告是否命名了后训练对象的来源和格式，是否把奖励主张与奖励实现区分开来，是否把评测脚手架与训练基础设施分开，以及是否公开了可能影响智能体安全结果的预算和能力条件。

应使用本卡片比较各前沿报告的披露边界，并识别数据、反馈或审计台账中仍需索取的证据。不要用它复现 Gemini 3 Pro 后训练、推断未披露的数据溯源或权利、把该过程标注为 RLVR，或把网络安全评测配置转换为训练 rollout 或产品推理主张。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat reasoning-model-generated thought traces as a stage-level disclosure, not as a released SFT corpus, trace schema, or generator manifest.
  • Keep the reported thought-length penalties separate from the undisclosed reward function, other reward signals, verifier, calibration, and RL implementation.
  • Treat the custom controller, retry rule, 75 attempts, 40-step challenges, and extra tools as cyber-evaluation scaffolding rather than post-training rollout evidence.
  • Preserve the roughly 75,000-prompt third-party evaluation as a reported aggregate; do not infer prompt release, evaluator identity, rubric availability, or reproducibility.
  • Compare this Card within Track 12's disclosure ledger and do not turn FSF capability assessments into training or scaling claims.

• 将“推理模型生成 thought traces”视为阶段级披露，而不是已发布的 SFT 语料、trace 模式或生成器清单。
  • 将所报告的 thought 长度惩罚与未披露的奖励函数、其他奖励信号、verifier、校准和 RL 实现严格区分。
  • 将自定义 controller、重试规则、75 次尝试、40 步挑战和额外工具视为网络安全评测脚手架，而不是后训练 rollout 证据。
  • 将约 75,000 个 prompts 的第三方评测保留为已报告的聚合量；不要推断 prompts 发布、评估者身份、rubric 可用性或可复现性。
  • 只在 Track 12 的披露台账内比较本卡片，不把 FSF 能力评估转化为训练或规模结论。
